AppProtocolVersion.description: Version of the canonical app data plane, independent of HTTP and SDKs.

AppRunStatus.description:
Stable public lifecycle for one logical app run.

Artifact V2 owns a richer internal execution state machine. This smaller
enum is the app protocol projection: clients never infer terminality from
an HTTP status code or from an open-ended internal status string.

description:
Stable response-loss replay receipt. `Cancelling` proves the intent is
durable; `Cancelled` is minted only from the protected pre-I/O proof and is
returned only after Artifact has committed the canonical terminal state.
title: AppActionCancellationReceipt
